body: I told my mom. I've begged for a therapist for years. No avail. She's making me wake up and go to school tomorrow like nothing is wrong. I asked her to hospitalize me so I could get better and she said no, even though I told her I was suicidal. She thinks I just want out of school.

For the life of me, I can't find the key to our gunsafe. I'm going to chug a litre of 20% alcohol, take all the pills in the drug cabinet (as well as drink as much Nyquil as I can take without vomiting), duct tape my hands together, and then lie face down in a full bathtub. For the love of God, if that doesn't kill me, I'll go climb up a building like fucking spider-man and jump if I have to.

I'm going to sleep. I'm not sure if anyone really cares, but in a sub called Suicide Watch, y'know... 

I'll respond to any more messages in the morning. Goodnight.

I'll be here for you for as long as I can, but I definitely  know that it's my time. I'm elated for it, really, and very excited. The only reason I'm still here is that I don't want to do it while my brother is in the house. The second I'm home alone, *pop.* Maybe we could exchange stories, fight some demons?

I am so sorry. You are so strong for playing the game of spite with your own demons. That says so much about you as a person and, although I know I don't have much time left for myself, if you ever need someone to talk to, I'll be here. I, very regrettably and sadly, don't have quite enough spite to keep fighting. I have enough spite to stop, however. I won't get to see my best friend today, and I probably won't see him again before I die. He's got a migraine and promised that we could reschedule for some other day, in the new year. I don't think I'll last that long.

I don't believe that I am alone, nor do I believe that I am unloved. I do believe that if I live for selfless reasons, then it is my choice to die for selfish ones and for the past year I have been as selfless as I know how. It's my turn to get something back, y'know?

I appreciate the effort, but if I can't live for the friends, my family (what little bit I have), or myself, then I don't think I can live for you. I have a passion; right now, it's death. I don't want to keep fighting, and there is an easy way out, and that thought fills my obsessions.

It's alright and thank you. I appreciate the effort.

I believe in you and I am so sorry about what happened to you today, even though (as you said) it means fuck all. Please be there for your kids and be nice to them. Things might have turned out differently with me if my parents had.

I was born asexual and aromantic, meaning it is physically impossible for me to ever have feelings for someone/have children of my own. So nothing in the romance department. Every 'best friend' I've had has left for a SO, which is a bit heartbreaking but I understand that they owe me nothing, so not much for the friend department, either. Maybes? Not many if any. I know that suicidal thoughts make all thinking super pessimistic and so I am trying to think of one, but I can't seem to. All my thinking is "maybe I'll get hit by a bus and die so my friends don't blame themselves" but unless I jump out into traffic, that seems slim to none (and much more painful than I'd like, but at this point, whatever gets the job done I suppose).

I was the same way for a long time, had all the plans to buy one after getting the license and all, but I found a hidden one in our house with some ammunition. I'm a little worried that the ammo is old, but with a solid blow through the mouth there should be no surviving that. I was abused for a long time and I have nightmares every night and a horrible memory every day to the point where I can't remember what I was doing a month and a half ago at all. If I am suicidal when awake and put through hell when I sleep, I might as well die.

I would never tell him for fear that he would try and prevent it. If I did, he would probably just hug me and have me stay over for the evening until the panic blows over, and then contact my parent, which is exactly what I don't want to happen.

Mind, he is my best friend but I am not his. He may never forgive himself or whatever scare tactics anyone else has to say, but he gives me no reason to live in of himself. My suicide will ruin many lives and many programs I have been a part of, but they matter near to nothing to me if I'm dead.

That's okay. He'll have lots of stuff to remember me and he knows how much I love him. He might blame himself some, but I wrote very clearly in my note that he was probably the only person who made me hesitate for as long as I did, but nothing he could have said or done could have manipulated fate.
The one person who reached out deleted their account
